payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP over (i,j) where state dp[i][j] is the maximum similarity score for substrings ending at positions i in A and j in B, with transitions handling character match/mismatch and allowing restart at 0.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a DP with two rows (current and previous) iterating over j then i, which is a standard space-optimized 2D DP. The recurrence dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j]-1, dp[i][j-1]-1, dp[i-1][j-1]+2 if match else -2, 0) matches a 2D state for substring pairs, not interval or 1D.
